competition_name: BUET CSE Fest Inter University CTF finals
description:
We are extremely proud and excited to share that our team “RUET_404_f14g_N0t_f0und” has been selected for the finals of the Inter University Capture The Flag (CTF) competition at United Group Presents BUET CSE Fest 2024, standing among the top teams out of 200+ participating teams from universities across the country.

This achievement reflects months of dedication, late-night practice sessions, problem-solving under pressure, and a deep passion for cybersecurity. Competing at such a high-profile national CTF has been an incredible learning experience, pushing us to sharpen our skills in areas like web exploitation, reverse engineering, cryptography, binary exploitation, digital forensics, and teamwork under real-world constraints.

We would like to express our special gratitude to Amio Ghosh and মো. তালহা বিন কবির, whose continuous support, guidance, and motivation played a significant role in this journey. Their insights and encouragement helped us stay focused and confident throughout the competition.

A special thanks to RUET Cyber Security Club for providing proper guidelines, learning resources, and a collaborative environment that nurtures cybersecurity enthusiasts. The club’s mentorship and culture of knowledge sharing have been instrumental in preparing teams to compete at a national level.

We also want to congratulate all the teams who made it to the finals and give a huge shout-out to fellow RUET teams — RUET_CyberSontrashi, RUET_OSM_z3r0day, and TEUReverse — for qualifying for the finals as well. It’s truly inspiring to see four teams from RUET making it this far, showcasing the growing strength of RUET in the national cybersecurity and CTF community.

This achievement motivates us even more to keep learning, practicing, and representing RUET with pride. Hopefully, in the coming years, we’ll see even more RUET teams dominating national and international CTF stages.

Onward to the finals — RUET goes stronger! 🚩🔥

From Top 5 hopes to finishing 13th, this CTF reminded us why Capture The Flag is a battlefield — unforgiving, competitive, and brutally honest. Our team OSAM_z3r0day secured 13th place among 254 teams at the Bangladesh Computer Society (BCS) CTF, and while it may not be the position we aimed for, it represents how far we’ve progressed and how much stronger we’ve become.

Every challenge tested our limits — from time management and strategy to deep technical skills and decision-making under pressure. This competition exposed our weaknesses, strengthened our mindset, and gave us clarity on what needs to improve. In CTFs, rankings don’t just measure performance — they measure preparation, adaptability, and teamwork.

This time, we learned.
Next time, we dominate.

A massive shout-out to Shoaib Bin Rashid, Md Oly Hossen, Mahfuz Mridul, and Md Sabbir Rahman for the relentless effort, teamwork, and dedication throughout the contest. Every solve, every failed attempt, and every last-minute push was a team effort.

This is not the end — it’s a checkpoint. We move forward sharper, hungrier, and more determined than ever.

On to the next battlefield. 🚩🔥

#CTF #CyberSecurity #Teamwork #Growth #OSAM_z3r0day

🚩 We made it to the onsite round! 🚩

Our team OSAM_z3r0day proudly secured 7th place in the UAP CYBER SIEGE 2025 – Online Preliminary Round, earning our spot in the onsite finals among some of the strongest teams in the competition.

This round was a true test of technical depth, speed, and teamwork — pushing us through challenges across multiple CTF domains and forcing us to think critically under pressure. Finishing in the top tier is not just a result, but proof of the consistent effort, preparation, and learning we’ve put in as a team.

A huge thank you to my incredible teammates — Shoaib Bin Rashid, Mahfuz Mridul, and Md Oly Hossen. Your dedication, problem-solving skills, and relentless teamwork made this achievement possible. Every flag captured was a collective win.

🎯 Next stop: the onsite final at University of Asia Pacific on May 3rd.
We’re gearing up to give it everything we’ve got and represent ourselves with confidence and determination.

The journey continues — see you at the battlefield. 🔥🚀

#CTF #CyberSecurity #OSAM_z3r0day #Teamwork #UAPCyberSiege #OnsiteFinal

We’re proud to share that Team OSAM_z3r0day secured 15th place among 224 teams—including both students and seasoned professionals from across Bangladesh—in the Phoenix Summit CTF 2025.

Out of 24 challenging problems, we managed to solve 13, pushing ourselves through intense problem-solving, tight timelines, and constant collaboration. This performance earned us a free pass to Phoenix Summit 2025, giving us the opportunity to represent RUET on a national stage, which means a lot to us as a team.

This CTF tested not only our technical skills but also our coordination, adaptability, and persistence. Every challenge taught us something new and helped us identify where we can grow stronger. We’re grateful for the journey, the lessons learned, and the progress we’ve made together.

A special thanks to Team Phoenix for organizing such a competitive and well-designed CTF and creating a platform that truly challenges and inspires the cybersecurity community.

We’ll take this experience forward, learn from it, and come back stronger.
The grind continues. 🚩🔥

#RUETCyberSecurityClub #PhoenixSummit2025 #CTF #OSAM_z3r0day

Team OSAM_z3r0day proudly participated in Hackathon 2025 – The Battleground of Ethical Hackers, a prestigious national-level CTF competition organized by MIST and powered by BTRC. Competing against some of the strongest ethical hacking teams from across Bangladesh, we secured 8th place in the onsite final round — a result that reflects both our potential and our journey so far. 🇧🇩

We started the competition with momentum and confidence. For the first two hours, we dominated the scoreboard, climbing all the way to 1st place — marking our first-ever top rank in a national CTF event. That moment was surreal and will always remain a milestone for us as a team. 💥

As the contest progressed, things didn’t go entirely our way. The final hours were tough, and we couldn’t maintain our position on the leaderboard. Dropping down was painful — we felt it deeply. But CTFs aren’t just about rankings; they’re about resilience, learning, and growth.

🔐 Every challenge taught us something new.
🚩 Every flag captured sharpened our skills.
🛠️ Every mistake showed us where we need to improve.

This experience reminded us why we love CTFs — they push you beyond comfort, expose weaknesses, and demand teamwork under pressure. We take this result not as a setback, but as motivation.

We’ll return stronger, smarter, and hungrier.
This is not the end — it’s only the beginning of our journey.

🚀 OSAM_z3r0day moves forward.

#OSAM_z3r0day #Hackathon2025 #CTF #EthicalHacking #MIST #CTFJourney #NeverGiveUp #LearningThroughFailure #CaptureTheFlag #BangladeshCyberCommunity #InfoSec #CyberSecurity

𝗢𝗦𝗔𝗠_𝘇3𝗿0𝗱𝗮𝘆 — back from a break and straight into the kitchen. 🔥

Out of 1,158 teams, we cooked our way to 32nd place worldwide, landing in the top ~2.7% internationally — not a bad comeback at all. And yes, we’re proud to say we finished as Bangladesh’s top-ranked team 🇧🇩🏆

BrunnerCTF 2025 served a full-course feast:
🍽️ Web, Crypto, Reverse, OSINT, Boot2Root, Forensics, Android, Pwn — plus a few secret ingredients we definitely weren’t warned about.

We stirred, baked, debugged, and sometimes winged it — but when it mattered, we turned up the heat. Every solve pushed us further, every stuck moment taught us something new, and every flag added to the flavor of the run.

This contest marked more than just a ranking — it marked our return, sharper and hungrier than before.

Now it’s time to rest, recharge, and get ready to break the next recipe. 💻🧑‍🍳
The kitchen stays hot.

#BrunnerCTF #CTF #OSAM_z3r0day

🚀 𝗢𝗦𝗔𝗠_𝗭𝟯𝗿𝟬𝗱𝗮𝘆 at 𝗛𝟰𝗰𝗸𝗰𝟬𝗻 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟱 𝗖𝗧𝗙 🚀

Another chapter added to our journey. We competed in H4ckc0n 2025 CTF and proudly secured 10th place worldwide 🌍 — standing shoulder to shoulder with some of the strongest teams in the global CTF community.

While we narrowly missed the Top 3, we’re proud to have maintained our position as the #1 team from Bangladesh 🇧🇩. Every contest like this sharpens us further and reminds us why we keep pushing our limits.

This isn’t the finish line — it’s a checkpoint.
🎯 Next stop: Top 3.

We’re grateful for the teamwork, the sleepless nights, and the relentless drive for hacking, learning, and improving. The grind doesn’t stop — it only gets stronger from here. 🔥💻

OSAM_Z3r0day moves forward.

#CTF #Hackcon2025 #OSAM_Z3r0day

🌍💥 6th Among the World’s Best 💥🌍

Our squad OSAM_z3r0day just wrapped up 07CTF — a 36-hour global hacking marathon — and we’re proud to finish 6th place worldwide 🏆🌐🔥

This run pushed us to our limits and then some:

⚔️ First Blood on one of the toughest challenges of the contest
🧠 Solved a few near-impossible problems that only a handful of teams managed to crack
🥇 Missed the Top 3 by inches — but for a team that’s been grinding CTFs for less than a year, this result is massive 💪

A special shoutout to our junior teammate Golam Rabbani, who jumped into his very first CTF with us and delivered under pressure 🙌 — the future is bright.

🏴‍☠️ This was only the warm-up.
⚡ More blood, more flags, more growth, more glory ahead 🚀🌍

OSAM_z3r0day keeps pushing forward.

🚩 RUET_OSAM_z3r0day at BUP CTF 2025 🚩

We came, we saw, we almost conquered… and landed 4th place 😎
Just one tiny inch away from the podium — close enough to taste the glory, far enough to keep us hungry for more. 🏆🥲

Huge thanks to Knight Squad and BUP Computer Programming Club for organizing an epic CTF — packed with challenging problems, intense competition, and moments we’ll definitely remember. 💻🔥

To the Top 3 — enjoy the view from above.
We’ll be coming for you very soon. 😉

The grind continues. 🚀

#RUET_OSAM_z3r0day #BUPCTF2025

I’m incredibly proud to share that we secured the 2nd Runner-up (3rd Place) position in the National Capture The Flag (CTF) Competition 2025, held at DIU CYBERCON 2025. Standing on the national podium among 120+ university and professional teams from across the country is a moment we’ll never forget.

This achievement reflects the countless hours of preparation, late-night CTF sessions, failed attempts, small breakthroughs, and relentless teamwork that brought us here. Competing under pressure at the national stage pushed us to our limits—and we rose to the challenge with sharp problem-solving, strong technical execution, and trust in one another.

👥 Team RUET_OSAM_z3r0day

Oly Hossen (CSE-21)

Arittro Sarkar (CSE-21)

Mahfuz Mridul (CSE-21)

Shoaib Bin Rashid (CSE-21)

Representing RUET on such a platform is an honor, and earning this result makes it even more special. This isn’t just a win for our team—it’s motivation to keep pushing, learning, and aiming higher.

The journey continues. 🚩🔥

#RUET #CyberSecurity #DIUCyberCon2025 #CTF #ProudMoment #TeamRUET #HackerSpirit #NationalFinals #Innovation #Excellence
